facts.fact: The World Bank's Malawi Economic Monitor says the Unified Beneficiary Registry is partially integrated with the management information systems of the Social Cash Transfer Program (SCTP) and the CS-EPWP public works programme, with data shared through a one-way API.
facts.system: SCTP and CS-EPWP management information systems

facts.fact: The World Bank's Malawi Economic Monitor says about 440,000 households across 10 districts are paid SCTP benefits or CS-EPWP wages electronically under the SSRLP.
facts.system: SCTP and CS-EPWP management information systems
